stem: Which statement is supported by the information in the graph?

options.label: F
options.text: The number of premium memberships sold during Week 4 was 75% more than the number of premium memberships sold during Week 1.

options.label: G
options.text: The total number of memberships sold during Week 1 was equal to the total number of memberships sold during Week 2.

options.label: H
options.text: The number of premium memberships sold during Week 3 was 2 times the number of premium memberships sold during Week 2.

options.label: J
options.text: The total number of memberships sold during Week 4 was 35 less than the total number of memberships sold during Week 3.

visual_elements: Bar graph titled Memberships showing Number of Memberships on vertical axis from 0 to 100, and Week on horizontal axis from 1 to 4. Two bars per week: Standard (gray) and Premium (black). Week 1: Standard 55, Premium 20; Week 2: Standard 45, Premium 25; Week 3: Standard 70, Premium 50; Week 4: Standard 60, Premium 95. Legend distinguishes Standard and Premium.
notes: The problem relates to interpreting a bar graph comparing standard and premium memberships sold over 4 weeks.
